reviews.title: Best Quality Always
reviews.comment: Typical Lian Li quality, which is to say outstanding. I've had many of their products over time and not one of them has disappointed. RGB Lighting and wire management are unequaled. Buy these, you won't be disappointed.
reviews.author: Terry C.

reviews.title: If you got the money, buy it.
reviews.comment:
First of all, these fans are hard to come by in a 3 pack WITH controller. So when I saw this I thought it was too good to be true.
Like any Lian Li product, it was easy to install. For better cable management get the wireless but if you wanna save some bucks (Lian Li hurting my pockets rn) get this. Controller is legit and comes with everything you need to set up the fans using the controller or regular 4-Pin PWM. As far as performance we'll have to see, but so far so good.
Thank you to whoever is selling these with the controller because I did not want to buy a Standard 3 Pack. These fans are beautiful and so customizable. Made me write a review for the first time!
reviews.author: Kyrin

reviews.title: Awesome fans
reviews.comment: Awesome fans easy to use & install I've bought 2 sets from them with no issues.
reviews.author: David E.

reviews.title: Awesome fans, but 7-pin plug
reviews.comment: The fans are great, however be advised that these are different and use a 7 pin plug and not the normal 4-pin that comes with other Lian Li fans. Thankfully I had an extra 4-pin Lian Li cable laying around otherwise I would have been sending these back.
reviews.author: Nate
